episodes.synopsis: Urban legends come to life…Everyone’s heard an urban legend before, but few have ever come face-to-face with one. These phenomena are everywhere, existing in the shadows of reality. More and more of them have been appearing in the wake of the faceless kid sighted all over Japan. If you see her or one of the urban legends she brings―pray the boy in the red hood finds you before it’s too late. You won’t stand a chance on your own.

title.romaji: Magical★Explorer: Eroge no Yuujin Chara ni Tensei Shitakedo, Game Chishiki Tsukatte Jiyuu ni Ikiru
title.native: マジカル★エクスプローラー　エロゲの友人キャラに転生したけど、ゲーム知識使って自由に生きる

manga: Magical★Explorer: Eroge no Yuujin Chara ni Tensei Shitakedo, Game Chishiki Tsukatte Jiyuu ni Ikiru
episodes.synopsis: Few titles are more revered among horndogs-(ahem) connoisseurs of Japanese erotic video games-than Magical Explorer. One day, our smut-loving hero wakes up to find he has been reincarnated into the body of the game’s dreamboat protagonist! Or rather, his hapless comic-relief best friend, Kousuke Takioto.

title.romaji: Seitokai ni mo Ana wa Aru!
title.english: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes!
title.native: 生徒会にも穴はある！

manga: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes!
Seitokai ni mo Ana wa Aru!
episodes.synopsis: This is Fujinasu Academy, a private high school with top-achieving students located on the outskirts of town. High School 1st-Year Ume Mizunoe has excellent grades in Japanese language class and has received multiple literary awards. However, his terrible grades in the sciences are affecting his ability to move up a grade. To avoid repeating a year, he becomes a member of the student council to improve his academic standing.

title.romaji: Kashita Maryoku wa [Revo Barai] de Kyousei Choushuu
title.english: Magic Repo Man: Dumped by My Party, I’ll Cash In With a Cute Support Fairy to Become the Strongest!
title.native: 貸した魔力は【リボ払い】で強制徴収

manga: Magic Repo Man: Dumped by My Party, I'll Cash In With a Cute Support Fairy to Become the Strongest!
Kashita Maryoku wa [Revo Barai] de Kyousei Choushuu ~Youzumi to Party Tsuihou sareta Ore wa, Kawaii Support Yousei to Issho ni Toritateta Maryoku wo Unyou shite Saikyou wo Mezasu.
episodes.synopsis: If there's one thing you can never have enough of in a world of RPG-style swords and sorcery, it's magic points! Whether you're fueling spells, techniques, or showing off an incredible ability, you've gotta spend those points to do real damage. But what if you run out? Lent is part of the up-and-coming party known as the “Skypiercers,” and thanks to his unique Gift, he can loan massive amounts of magic to others. No MP?

title.native: おでかけ子ザメ シーズン2
ゆるゆる図鑑

episodes.synopsis: Gakken's hugely popular illustrated encyclopedia series, which everyone can enjoy with its laid-back four-panel comics, is finally being adapted into a TV anime! Discover surprising aspects and fun facts about living creatures—full of secrets that will make you say, "Wow!" Enjoy this new kind of anime that makes even scary things fun and easy to watch, with its cute art style.

title.native: タヌキとキツネ

episodes.synopsis: The story centers on the daily lives of a raccoon dog who is not quite with it and a mischievous fox who likes to tease the raccoon dog. The two are close friends who live together on a mountain. Their other friends include a wolf, a bear, a rabbit, and birds.

title.native: コウペンちゃん

episodes.synopsis: The story of the series follows the everyday adventures of Koupen-chan and his friends as they enjoy the little things in life.

title.native: ぷにるんず ぷに４
おねがいアイプリ

episodes.synopsis: The latest entry in the Pretty Series franchise and a new chapter in the AiPri series. Note: Relations are provisional and will be updated when more info is announced.

title.native: ポップパップポルターズ
アオアシ 第2期

episodes.synopsis: Aoi Ashito’s game has now earned him a spot on the A team, but he is quickly overwhelmed by his harsh new reality. Surrounded by elite players like Kuribayashi and Akutsu, practices are just as merciless as the matches. In this U-18 Premier League of powerhouse talent, Ashito must evolve or be crushed, if he’s ever to be acknowledged.

title.romaji: Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen 2nd Season Part 2
title.native: 夜桜さんちの大作戦 第2期 第2クール

episodes.synopsis: The second cour of the second season of Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen .

title.romaji: Diamond no Ace act II: Second Season Part 2
title.english: Ace of the Diamond act II -Second Season-
title.native: ダイヤのA actⅡ -Second Season- 第2クール

manga: Ace of the Diamond Act II
episodes.synopsis: The Seido baseball club has been invited to the spring invitational at the hallowed Koshien Stadium. Sawamura will finally stand on the mound! Standing between Seido and the national title are the winners of last year's summer tournament Komadai Fujimaki and their unstoppable ace Masamune Hongo. Can Seido triumph over Komadai? It's the start of another heated battle in youth baseball!

title.native: ホロのぐらふぃてぃ

episodes.synopsis: From unraveling the secrets of opening and closing doors to defusing surprise packages more commonly known as bombs, there is never a dull day at the Hololive Production office! Holo no Graffiti follows an eccentric cast of Virtual YouTubers, also known as "VTubers," going about their absurd yet hilarious daily lives, detailing all their cute moments and mishaps.

title.native: サザエさん

episodes.synopsis: The main character is a mother named Sazae-san. She lives in a house with her husband, her kid, her siblings and her parents. The show is the ultimate family program and tends to follow traditional themes. Think of this show as the Japanese equivalent to "The Partridge Family" and you'll get a good feel for this show's atmosphere. Don't expect to see things like violence, swearing, kung-fu action or magical girls.

title.native: うまゆるふるげ〜と!

episodes.synopsis: "Umayuru" is a short anime series featuring pint-sized Uma Musume! This time, it’s a "Full-Gate" three-minute race where *all* the Uma Musume take to the track! A super-sized, laid-back gathering with everyone!

title.romaji: Mezametara Saikyou Soubi to Uchuusen-mochi datta node, Ikkodate Mezashite Youhei to shite Jiyuu ni Ikitai
title.english: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship!
title.native: 目覚めたら最強装備と宇宙船持ちだったので、一戸建て目指して傭兵として自由に生きたい

manga: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship!
Mezametara Saikyou Soubi to Uchuusen-mochi datta node, Ikkodate Mezashite Youhei to shite Jiyuu ni Ikitai
episodes.synopsis: Sato Takahiro was an ordinary office worker and hobbyist gamer until the day he woke up on a spaceship–one that strangely resembled a craft from a favorite space-shooter game. With a decked-out ship, a crew full of babes, and a fantastic universe to explore, he's going to make the most of his good luck and create the life he's always dreamed of!

title.romaji: Oji-san wa Kawaii Mono ga Osuki.
title.native: おじさんはカワイイものがお好き。

manga: Oji-san wa Kawaii Mono ga Osuki.
episodes.synopsis: By day, Mitsutaka Oji is the handsome, dependable boss everyone admires. By night, he dotes on his favorite mascot, Pugtaro, and indulges his secret obsession with all things cute! He's kept his double life hidden for years—but one unexpected encounter turns everything upside down and forces Oji to face his feelings head-on!

title.native: 魔法の姉妹ルルットリリィ 第2クール

episodes.synopsis: The second half of Mahou no Shimai LuluttoLilly.

title.native: TANK CHAIR-戦車椅子-

episodes.synopsis: Shizuka takes on the most dangerous of assassin jobs, but she's not the one doing the killing. Rather, it's her brother, Nagi, a strong assassin who took a bullet to protect his sister, leaving him in a comatose state and having to use a wheelchair. However, Shizuka has figured out the key to waking her brother up: he must be faced with killing intent! Thus begins a violent journey of recovery, battling the most dangerous foes!

title.native: ドラゴンボール超 ビルス

episodes.synopsis: Several years have passed since the fierce battle against Majin Buu, and Earth has finally regained a brief moment of peace. At the same time, Beerus, the God of Destruction, awakens from his long, deep sleep. Even Kai and Supreme Kai, aware of Beerus's overwhelming power to destroy entire planets, watch his awakening with great fear… Meanwhile, Beerus hears rumors of a Saiyan who defeated Frieza—and suddenly appears before Goku.

title.romaji: Tensei Kizoku, Kantei Skill de Nariagaru 3rd Season
title.english: As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World Season 3
title.native: 転生貴族、鑑定スキルで成り上がる 第3期

manga: As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World
Tensei Kizoku Kantei Skill de Nariagaru: Jakushou Ryouchi wo Uketsuidanode, Yuushuuna Jinzai wo Fuyashite Itara, Saikyou Ryouchi ni Natteta
episodes.synopsis: The third season of Tensei Kizoku, Kantei Skill de Nariagaru . Note: On September 4, 2026, it was announced that GeyeG Pictures would take over the production from studio MOTHER while keeping the same staff.

title.romaji: Yowaki MAX Reijou Nano ni, Ratsuwan Konyakusha-sama no Kake ni Notte Shimatta
title.english: Even Though I'm a Super Timid Noble Girl, I Accepted the Bet From My Cunning Fiancé
title.native: 弱気MAX令嬢なのに、辣腕婚約者様の賭けに乗ってしまった

manga: Yowaki MAX Reijou Nano ni, Ratsuwan Konyakusha-sama no Kake ni Notte Shimatta
episodes.synopsis: I was reborn as a villainous daughter in a reverse harem otome game. After being sick with a high fever at the age of 10, Pia Rockwell suddenly remembered her past life as a university student in Japan. But far from going down the villainess route, all this super timid girl wants is to finally use her knowledge from when she was a grad student studying to get her doctorate in paleontology.

title.romaji: Shinja Zero no Megami-sama to Hajimeru Isekai Kouryaku
title.english: Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers
title.native: 信者ゼロの女神サマと始める異世界攻略

manga: Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers
Shinja Zero no Megami-sama to Hajimeru Isekai Kouryaku
episodes.synopsis: RPG player Makoto Takatsuki is hurled into another world with awful skills and stats. But he soon meets a goddess named Noah, who asks him to become her 1st believer in return for blessings.

title.native: テムパル～アイテムの力～

episodes.synopsis: Sin Yeong-U (a.k.a. Grid), an unlucky man in life and a low-level player in the popular VR game “Satisfy,” finds a powerful item that earns him a rare legendary class title: “Pagma’s Successor.” He’s now a skilled blacksmith who can forge unique weapons and equip the game’s most powerful gear.

title.native: ホテル・インヒューマンズ 第2期
彼方から

episodes.synopsis: On her way home from school one day, Noriko is unexpectedly plunged into a strange and extraordinary fantasy world. Her troubles compound exponentially when she is rescued and befriended by a handsome young man by the name of Izark. He may be brave and courageous, but inside Izark lurks the darkest evil imaginable. And according to an ancient prophecy, Noriko possesses the power to unleash that evil.

title.romaji: Mouse Cursor de Genjitsu wo Sousa Dekiru You ni Natta node, Onnanoko wo Ippai Click Shimasu
title.english: Now That I Can Control Reality With A Mouse Cursor, I'm Gonna Click Away On The Girls!
title.native: マウスカーソルで現実を操作できるようになったので、女の子をいっぱいクリックしまーす

manga: Mouse Cursor de Genjitsu wo Sousa Dekiru You ni Natta node, Onnanoko wo Ippai Click Shimasu
episodes.synopsis: What if you could control reality with a mouse cursor? One day during class, Takumi— an otaku — notices his mouse cursor has sprung out of the screen. Panicked, he asks his childhood friend Mone, sitting next to him, to take a look, only to be brushed off... Once Takumi realizes he could actually control it himself, he uses the mouse cursor— visible only to him— to slip it in between Mone's clothes and starts clicking away...

title.native: 彼女の友達

episodes.synopsis: For the first time in my life, I have a girlfriend. But her friend tempts me with a body that's so seductive... What would you do if your girlfriend's friend came on to you like this?

title.romaji: Kanojo no Tomodachi Mini Anime Gekijou
title.native: 彼女の友達 ミニアニメ劇場

episodes.synopsis: A weekly mini anime shown with each episode of Kanojo no Tomodachi exclusively on the AT-X broadcast of the TV anime and online on OceanVeil.

title.native: ダークサモナーとデキている

episodes.synopsis: Amona’s a dark summoner with demonic powers. Roni’s a devout priest who’s way too uptight. By all rights, they should hate each other. Instead, they end up fast-tracking their enemies-to-lovers arc with a one-night stand that somehow insists on becoming a recurring event.

title.romaji: JK Dark Summoner to Deki......Dei Nai!?
title.native: JKダークサモナーとデキ。。。。。。でいない!?

episodes.synopsis: A weekly mini anime shown with each episode of Dark Summoner to Dekiteiru exclusively on the AT-X broadcast of the TV anime and online on Abema.

title.native: ゆうさんち！from 遊ハち

manga: Ah, Tanuki wa Mou Dame desu

title.native: 猫猫のひとりごと 第3期

episodes.synopsis: Chibi shorts to Kusuriya no Hitorigoto 3rd Season released on the TOHO animation YouTube channel. Note: Episode count begins at 49.

title.romaji: Doumo, Suki na Hito ni Horegusuri wo Irai Sareta Majo desu.
title.english: Hello, I am a Witch and my Crush Wants me to Make a Love Potion!
title.native: どうも、好きな人に惚れ薬を依頼された魔女です。

manga: Hello, I am a Witch and my Crush Wants me to Make a Love Potion!
Doumo, Suki na Hito ni Horegusuri wo Irai Sareta Majo desu.
episodes.synopsis: “Make me a love potion.” And with that single sentence, the Good Witch of the Lake’s secret crush on the dashing Sir Harij ends in heartbreak. Still, when he promises to help her gather the ingredients, Rose is thrilled at the chance to gaze upon a man she’d normally never get to interact with.

title.english: So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin?
title.native: 転生ゴブリンだけど質問ある？

manga: So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin?
episodes.synopsis: Office worker Akira Yagami’s altruistic nature usually gets him the short end of the stick. When he dies after saving a kid from oncoming traffic...he reincarnates in another world as a goblin?! Normally, goblins only live for seven days, but Akira’s newfound powers let him defy the species’ normal life span...and are the key to his path to becoming the strongest goblin ever! Note: Tensei Goblin Dakedo Shitsumon Aru?

title.native: PSYREN -サイレン-

episodes.synopsis: One day, high schooler Ageha Yoshina picks up a mysterious “red phone card” left behind in a public telephone booth. A few days later, his childhood friend and classmate, Sakurako Amamiya—who possessed the same card—suddenly vanishes without a trace.

title.native: 魔法少女育成計画 restart

episodes.synopsis: Some magical girls fight. Others do not. Chosen by the mysterious Land of Magic, which exists unbeknownst to the rest of the world, magical girls are each granted a unique power. Pechka, whose magic makes food delicious, is forced to take part in a mysterious virtual game together with 16 unfamiliar magical girls, each with her own distinctive personality.
